name: Lakeshire
summary: Lakeshire's defenders face attacks from orcs, gnolls, and murlocs along Lake Everstill. Magistrate Solomon leads the town, while Marshal Marris commands its guard.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Lakeshire once offered peace in the foothills east of Stormwind. Now it is the kingdom's hardest-pressed frontier. Blackrock clan orcs swept down from the north and overran the garrison at Stonewatch Keep. Dark wizardry stirred Shadowhide gnolls into organized raiding parties. Blackrock saboteurs also broke parts of the Everstill Bridge. Foreman Oslow and his crew struggle to mend the span under threat of attack. Murlocs crowd the lake's shores, while gnolls stalk the high passes. Lakeshire's defenders are close to breaking.

sections.title: Abandoned by the Crown
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon sent repeated pleas for help across the mountains, but Stormwind City provided almost no soldiers. The kingdom's resources were drained by internal strife, and royal councilors dismissed Redridge's danger as exaggerated border skirmishes. Dwarven reinforcements sent from Ironforge were ambushed and vanished in the Burning Steppes. Marshal Marris and his few remaining guards held the barricades alone. Lakeshire depended on the courage of roaming mercenaries and freelance adventurers hired from the town hall.

aliases: who is in charge of lakeshire
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon governs Lakeshire from the town hall. Marshal Marris leads local defense and policing with the battered remains of the town guard.

faq.q: Why won't Stormwind send soldiers to help Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Stormwind's forces are stretched thin by unrest across the region. Royal councilors, especially Lady Katrana Prestor, persuaded Highlord Bolvar Fordragon not to send standing troops to Redridge, so the Crown relied on deputized adventurers.

faq.q: What happened to the Everstill Bridge?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs damaged the stone bridge during their raids across the lake, disrupting trade and transport. Foreman Oslow oversees repairs, but missing tools and continuing attacks have slowed the work.

faq.q: What threats currently surround the town?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs hold Stonewatch Keep to the east, Shadowhide gnolls under rogue sorcerer Morganth strike from the northern hills, and aggressive murlocs infest Lake Everstill's waters and banks.

angles.text: Lakeshire guards Stormwind's eastern border. If the Blackrock clan takes the town, orcs could reach Elwynn's heartlands directly.
As a human, you can see Lakeshire's hard-won resilience. Rebuilt after the wars against the Horde, it gives Stormwind refugees who refuse to flee their homeland again a place to stand.
